page.notes: <note side="left">In vita Ada-mi.</note> Note: the Arabic and Greek words are transcribed from the scan and may contain small errors; the Greek word after "lapis" (τὸ Βαί[?]) and the Greek word after "Quod ad" (ἀποσωτήριον[?]) are doubtful. "mox dicetur" is read as "mox", the first letter being uncertain on the scan. The left-margin note's hyphenation ("Ada-mi") is uncertain; a dot-like mark may stand for the hyphen. The printed hyphen in "la-pis" is a soft break and is not printed; "la-pis" is printed as one word across the line and is written here as "lapis". Line "Safiod-dinus" retains its printed hyphen at the line end.
